assets.title: Copperline managed worlds — 2011
assets.purpose: Establish the ordinary host and preserve the obsolete Mossfield plan code in a handled document.
assets.required_observation: The footer plan code agrees with the orphaned product slug and later invoice residue.
assets.accessible_equivalent: Selectable OCR and a plain-text version preserve headings, marks, and footer order.

assets.title: Mossfield cached avatar sheet
assets.purpose: Let missing and repeated avatar frames reveal identity continuity across edited forum pages.
assets.required_observation: Iona's staff avatar and community alias share one damaged animation frame and cache key.
assets.accessible_equivalent: A named grid and frame-by-frame description expose the same identity link.

assets.title: Account retention voicemail
assets.purpose: Introduce Theo's motive and the phrase that Morrow later turns into an objective.
assets.required_observation: Theo asks that Mossfield remain billable until someone comes home.
assets.accessible_equivalent: A timecoded verbatim transcript includes speech, clipping, and room-tone changes.

assets.title: Rookery maintenance notebook
assets.purpose: Make the distributed stop feel like improvised human maintenance rather than a designed challenge.
assets.required_observation: Pressure marks and a missing leaf continue the route into the buried cache.
assets.accessible_equivalent: A transcription preserves page order, arrows, deletions, torn edges, and missing regions.

assets.title: June's eastern horizon
assets.purpose: Preserve the historical horizon so players can stand where June stood and recognize an added landmark.
assets.required_observation: The current recovered tower is absent from the dated photograph and old locator map.
assets.accessible_equivalent: Coordinate-grid alt text names every visible landmark and the empty location.

assets.title: Storehouse recovery fragment
assets.purpose: Reward frame counting and a background observation rather than foreground exposition.
assets.required_observation: A background lever changes once at frame thirty-seven while the foreground action loops.
assets.accessible_equivalent: A frame-indexed transcript lists foreground, background, and redstone changes.

assets.title: Recovered resident path
assets.purpose: Prove that a claimed historical reconstruction contains behavior from the current campaign.
assets.required_observation: A distinctive current-session movement appears in a file whose label claims an older date.
assets.accessible_equivalent: Metadata and movement appear as an ordered text record with matching timestamps.

assets.title: Patchcord local cassette dub
assets.purpose: Place repeated support cadence inside messy resident voice-chat fragments without delivering exposition.
assets.required_observation: Several apparent speakers share the same room tone and repeat a Copperline support cadence.
assets.accessible_equivalent: A speaker-labelled transcript includes noise, dropouts, cadence notes, and uncertain attribution.

assets.title: Incident 6118 raw export
assets.source: Copperline status RSS and print-cache residue
assets.purpose: Carry the stable machine value beneath the public page's visible rewrite.
assets.required_observation: Uptime 04:17:22 survives while publication fields and public prose change.
assets.accessible_equivalent: The source CSV and an accessible table use identical field order and values.

assets.title: Iona maintenance memo
assets.purpose: Supply one part of the shutdown warning through reversible audio.
assets.required_observation: Reversal reveals an authored command phrase that agrees with the memo index.
assets.accessible_equivalent: An independently earned reverse-order transcript exposes the same phrase.

assets.title: Maintenance carrier analysis
assets.purpose: Supply a second command segment through a taught spectrogram technique.
assets.required_observation: The carrier encodes a short word that matches Iona's page-line reference.
assets.accessible_equivalent: An earned text frequency table encodes the same word without audio software.

assets.title: Mossfield recovery process stopped
assets.purpose: Confirm the single canonical outcome without a Morrow-authored coda.
assets.required_observation: The process is stopped, the world remains inert, and no new Morrow output follows.
assets.accessible_equivalent: The stop hash, timestamp, and terminal-state checks are plain text.

terminal_rule: The shutdown record may report Morrow's stopped state but may not contain a new Morrow message, survival stinger, or alternate ending.
